projects.intro: Representative engineering outcomes from regulated data programs. Client-sensitive implementation details are intentionally omitted.

items.title: Clinical Data Lakehouse Modernization
items.challenge: Improve pipeline reliability and analytical performance across governed clinical datasets.
items.approach: Led a five-person engineering team and implemented a medallion architecture using Amazon S3, Apache Iceberg, and Spark-based processing.

items.title: Clinical Document Intelligence
items.challenge: Turn high-volume clinical documents into traceable, review-ready data without increasing manual processing effort.
items.approach: Engineered an event-driven document pipeline with AWS Lambda and Textract, including validation and governed delivery workflows.

items.title: Clinical Data Standardization
items.challenge: Increase consistency and reuse across clinical trial transformation and reporting workflows.
items.approach: Designed reusable Python-based pipeline patterns aligned with CDISC SDTM and ADaM standards and regulated quality controls.

highlights: Leading a global pharmaceutical data transformation program, redesigning clinical trial data engineering and regulatory submission workflows using Python, CDISC SDTM, and cloud-native data platforms.
Building a specialized engineering organization, setting technical direction, developing the team, and coordinating delivery across multiple workstreams.
Architecting standardized clinical data pipelines for consistent regulatory reporting and compliance.
Developed enterprise data APIs and microservices for secure access to clinical datasets with ALCOA+ traceability.
Built GenAI applications for document summarization and semantic search across research data.
Led a 5-member data engineering team, defined the technical roadmap, and mentored engineers on pipeline best practices.
Architected Medallion Architecture on S3 + Apache Iceberg; reduced pipeline downtime by 40% and optimized Spark runtime by 30%.
Built Python/SQL pipelines for clinical trial data ingestion, transformation, and governed sharing.
Engineered an AWS Lambda and Textract platform that processes more than 20,000 clinical documents monthly.
Automated large-scale bioinformatics workflows using Python, R, and Bash.
Open-sourced a PyMOL plugin adopted globally for protein analysis and visualization.
